title: Effects of cuproptosis and its application in inflammatory bowel disease (Review).
snippet: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), which includes ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease, is a common, recurring, chronic intestinal inflammatory illness that is considered to be impacted by the immune system, gut microbiota and genetic factors. title: Gut‑liver‑kidney axis: A systems biology framework for understanding and treating chronic kidney disease (Review).
